en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a changing of the guard at a military barracks. Uniformed soldiers with rifles stand in formation near a striped sentry box and gate beside a substantial stone building. Officers and other men watch from stairs and the background yard. Red printed caption text appears along the bottom and vertically at the right edge, with a large red handwritten number at the top right.
